title: WP - 2026-10-23 - Severin Joho and Enzo Rossi: The evolution of frequency, language complexity and policy narrative: benchmarking Python-based NLP and ChatGPT on a century of SNB rhetoric
summary: We compiled and processed a novel, comprehensive dataset of 1,063 speeches delivered by high-ranking Swiss National Bank officials between 1928 and 2024. Beyond tracking their quantitative evolution, we conducted an in-depth analysis of the length, readability and thematic content. To ensure robust results, we benchmarked traditional Python-based NLP text mining against generative artificial intelligence using ChatGPT. Our findings highlight four primary policy insights. First, the frequency of annual speeches has followed an upward trajectory since the mid-1950s, accelerating notably after the transition to flexible exchange rates. Second, a clear shift toward brevity is evident. Third, the language has become increasingly accessible since the 1960s. Fourth, inflation has moved to the forefront of the thematic discourse in the era of flexible exchange rates, while cyclical economic development and unemployment have received less emphasis. title: German economic recovery temporarily interrupted
summary: German economic output is likely to have stagnated in the third quarter of 2026, the Bundesbank writes in its current Monthly Report. The economists attribute this interruption of the upward trend to temporary stress factors, however. These include the low water levels on the Rhine, the loss of competitiveness in the context of the Iran war and one-off effects related to the fuel rebate. In addition, high energy prices weighed on households’ purchasing power. The inflation rate rose significantly in September to its highest level since the end of 2023. The economists expect inflation to remain elevated for the time being.
